description: Quantify conservation of the GLIPR1L2 C-terminal insertion-competent helix across mammalian orthologs and summarise the Phobius signal-peptide/TM predictions for GLIPR1L2, its N-terminally truncated form, GLIPR1 and GLIPR1L1
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
HESSA=dict(zip("AILMFVWYGPCSTNQHRKDE",[0.11,-0.60,-0.55,-0.23,-0.32,-0.31,0.30,0.68,0.74,2.23,-0.13,0.84,0.52,2.05,2.36,2.06,2.58,2.71,3.49,2.68]))
def dGmin(seq,w=19):
    v=[sum(HESSA.get(a,0) for a in seq[i:i+w]) for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)]
    i=int(np.argmin(v)); return i+1,i+w,float(v[i])

q=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:GLIPR1L2+AND+taxonomy_id:40674"
   "&fields=accession,organism_name,length,sequence&format=json&size=200")
js=requests.get(q,timeout=90,headers=H).json()
orths={}
for e in js["results"]:
    org=e["organism"]["scientificName"]; L=e["sequence"]["length"]
    if org not in orths or L>orths[org][0]: orths[org]=(L,e["sequence"]["value"],e["primaryAccession"])

rec=[]
for org,(L,s,acc) in orths.items():
    a,b,g=dGmin(s); rec.append(dict(organism=org,acc=acc,length=L,start=a,end=b,dG=g,rel=b/L,seg=s[a-1:b]))
d=pd.DataFrame(rec)
full=d[d.length>=280].copy()       # near-full-length entries only
frag=d[d.length<280]
print(f"Total mammalian GLIPR1L2 entries (longest per species): {len(d)}")
print(f"Near-full-length (>=280 aa): {len(full)}   |  short/fragment (<280 aa): {len(frag)}")
print(f"\nAmong near-full-length orthologs ({len(full)} species):")
print(f"  with a C-terminal (rel. pos > 0.65) insertion-favourable 19-mer, dGapp < 0 : "
      f"{((full.dG<0)&(full.rel>0.65)).sum()}/{len(full)} "
      f"({100*((full.dG<0)&(full.rel>0.65)).mean():.1f}%)")
print(f"  median dGapp = {full.dG.median():.2f} kcal/mol  (IQR {full.dG.quantile(.25):.2f} to {full.dG.quantile(.75):.2f})")
print(f"  median relative position of the segment = {full.rel.median():.3f}")
print(f"\nShort entries (<280 aa) best-window relative position: median {frag.rel.median():.3f} "
      f"-> these are N-terminal fragments lacking the C-terminus, not TM-less orthologs.")

# residue-level conservation of the human TM 254-274 across full-length orthologs
hum=""
hyd=set("AILMFVWYCGV")
segs=full.seg.tolist()
cols=np.array([[1 if c in hyd else 0 for c in s] for s in segs])
print(f"\nHydrophobic-character conservation across the {len(segs)} orthologous best-insertion 19-mers:")
print("  per-column fraction hydrophobic:", np.round(cols.mean(0),2))
print(f"  mean over all columns: {cols.mean():.3f}")

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.25,1]})
ax[0].scatter(full.rel,full.dG,s=26,c="#2b6cb0",label=f"near-full-length (n={len(full)})",zorder=3)
ax[0].scatter(frag.rel,frag.dG,s=26,c="#a0aec0",marker="^",label=f"short entries (n={len(frag)})",zorder=3)
h=full[full.organism=="Homo sapiens"]
ax[0].axhline(0,color="#c05621",ls="--",lw=1)
ax[0].annotate("dGapp = 0\n(insertion threshold)",(0.02,0.3),fontsize=8,color="#c05621")
ax[0].scatter([254/344*1.0],[-4.72],s=90,facecolor="none",edgecolor="#e53e3e",lw=2,zorder=4)
ax[0].annotate("human Q4G1C9\nTM 254-274",(254/344,-4.72),xytext=(0.42,-6.4),fontsize=8,
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#e53e3e"),color="#e53e3e")
ax[0].set_xlabel("relative position of the most insertion-favourable 19-mer")
ax[0].set_ylabel("Hessa dGapp (kcal/mol)")
ax[0].set_title("GLIPR1L2 mammalian orthologs: a single C-terminal\ninsertion-competent helix is conserved",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left")

labels=["GLIPR1L2\niso1 (344)","GLIPR1L2\ntrunc 23-344","GLIPR1\niso1 (266)","GLIPR1L1\niso1 (242)"]
sp=[0,1,1,1]; tm=[1,1,1,0]
xx=np.arange(4); w=0.38
ax[1].bar(xx-w/2,sp,w,color="#38a169",label="signal peptide predicted")
ax[1].bar(xx+w/2,tm,w,color="#e53e3e",label="transmembrane helix predicted")
ax[1].set_xticks(xx); ax[1].set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=8); ax[1].set_yticks([0,1])
ax[1].set_yticklabels(["no","yes"]); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title("Phobius predictions: the UniProt canonical GLIPR1L2 start\nabolishes the signal peptide, the TM helix is unaffected",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
